name: NavigationMenuLink
description: Link to a page in the navigation menu. Set `current` on the link for the page the user is on. Renders an `<a>` element.

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class applied to the element, or a function that returns a class based on the component’s state.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the link as the current page, applying the active style and setting `aria-current="page"`.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the link, blocking all interactions. Removes `href` and sets `aria-disabled` on the `<a>` element. Takes precedence over `disabled` on `NavigationMenu.Root`.

props.name: closeOnClick
props.description: Whether to close the navigation menu when the link is clicked.

props.name: style
props.detailedType: React.CSSProperties | ((state: NavigationMenu.Link.State) => (React.CSSProperties | undefined)) | ((state: NavigationMenuLinkState) => (React.CSSProperties | undefined)) | undefined
props.description: Style applied to the element, or a function that returns a style object based on the component’s state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: NavigationMenu.Link.State) => ReactElement) | ((props: React.DetailedHTMLProps<React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>, HTMLAnchorElement>, state: NavigationMenuLinkState) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
